notes:
- Improved F2 menu reliability.
- Optional match profile picture sharing.
- Own Titles retained; Title sharing removed.
- Automatic maintenance lock for new RL versions.
changelogNotes:
- Fixed the F2 menu rejecting keypresses when its cached foreground status lagged behind Rocket League. The input helper now queries the foreground process with limited access rights, and the menu can request a fresh check without launching another process. A passive input fallback handles unavailable global shortcuts. The transparent, preloaded menu and same-key close behavior remain available.
- Added optional, match-only profile picture sharing with separate Steam/Epic controls, all off by default. Sharing connections are prepared only through Launch RL after opting in. Turning sharing off closes its listener and revokes peer access; the next closed-game UI preparation uses local-only resources. Steam retains its official own avatar. Own Epic profile pictures keep their full 512px image quality.
- Removed peer Title sharing and its native adapters from the release. Your own normal Titles and Plus Custom Titles remain client-sided and visible through the existing local display.
- Hardened profile picture teardown by retaining in-flight loaders, bitmap libraries and displayed textures for their owning movie's lifetime. Immutable resources are reused and their number is bounded. The legacy frame callback that dereferenced native avatar rows is now inert. Game class layouts, constructors and unrelated graphics remain unchanged.
- Added a full-app maintenance lock for unrecognized installed Rocket League executables. All detected installations and the saved selection are checked at startup, and the selected game is checked again before Launch RL. The supported Steam/Epic builds are shipped with the app. BondoMod update checks remain accessible while locked.
- Improved cross-version session recovery and crash diagnostics. Optional portrait preparation failures produce a feature warning instead of blocking Rocket League. Unknown game UI files are still rejected rather than overwritten.
- Preserved item spawning, item sharing, presets, local Titles and Plus-only coloured Alpha Boost behavior. Profile picture and Title sharing do not enter the item-sharing payload.
